crossRefs.note: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor I determined…
When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”
He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before…
Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will…
For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
I fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
“When I had returned to Jerusalem, and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance,
and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning…
When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you…
For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
If then God gave to them the same gift as us, when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could…
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

translations.web: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”
translations.bsb: A great clamor arose, and some scribes from the party of the Pharisees got up and contended sharply, “We find nothing wrong with this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?”
translations.kjv: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight
translations.asv: And there arose a great clamor: and some of the scribes of the Pharisees part stood up, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: and what if a spirit hath spoken to him, or an angel?
